# Two people command the whiteboard at once, twice; sorting, satellites and undo.
@voice Kim Karen
@voice Rishi Rishi
@voice Tessa Tessa
Kim: Let's list the options for the conference venue.
Rishi: Lisbon, Berlin and Austin came up last time.
Kim [command]: Whiteboard, make a group called venues with Lisbon, Berlin and Austin.
& Rishi [command]: Whiteboard, add a note to the notes panel: the budget is fifty thousand.
@pause 4
Tessa [distractor]: We sketched these on a whiteboard last week anyway.
Tessa [command]: Whiteboard, sort the venues alphabetically.
@pause 3
Rishi: Austin is the most expensive, I think.
Kim [command]: Whiteboard, add a con under Austin: expensive flights.
& Tessa [command]: Whiteboard, add a pro under Lisbon: good weather.
@pause 4
Kim [question]: Whiteboard, which venue comes first on the list?
@pause 5
Rishi [command]: Whiteboard, undo the last change.
@pause 4
